//.about: Copy this file OUTSIDE Git, fill in the keys you need, point AR_CREATE_CONFIG (or --config) at it. Every path below is an invented example. Remove this '//' block if you like; it is ignored.
//.home: Installed home only. Absolute path of the permanent home; serve.mjs must live at <home>/service/serve.mjs. Leave null for the demo or a candidate checkout.
//.dataDir: Absolute directory for saved work. Must be outside the checkout and, unless allowScratchRoots is true, not under ~/.codex, /tmp, /private/tmp or /private/var/folders. Env AR_CREATE_DATA_DIR / --data-dir override it.
//.port: Env AR_CREATE_PORT / --port override it. 8841 is refused unless 'home' is set and dataDir is <home>/data.
//.allowScratchRoots: Tests and the disposable demo only. Lets dataDir and the transcript roots sit under a scratch folder.
//.syntheticFixtures: true shows the invented demo projects. Leave false for real work.
//.fixturesDir: Folder holding a private replacement for synthetic-study-data.js. Served only to loopback. Null = none.
//.relocationFile: Installed home only. Exact owner/root relocation proof JSON produced by the integrator.
//.magazineCheckReceipts: Default false. Enables human-requested saved mechanical check receipts for exact registered Magazine pieces and configured original inputs. Stores private findings under dataDir; never changes manuscripts, original CHECK files, editorial approval or publication state. The review proxy needs its own explicit flag.
//.studyOriginalRoots: Read-only original roots. catalog.projects maps a project key to {title, docs:[[path,label]], audio:[], relatedProjects:[]}; catalog.drafts maps a draft id to {parentStudyKey, partKey, title, path, contextScope, support:[[path,label]]}. Paths are relative to vaultRoot.
//.originalReaderBaseUrl: http(s) base URL of a reader for originals, or null.
//.editorialSkillsDir: Folder with arcreate/ and mag/ skill files. Null = none.
//.editorialSkills: Optional explicit skill file paths. Derived from editorialSkillsDir when empty.
//.magazine: The Teajia magazine. vaultRoot = the Magazine folder in the vault (TEMPLATE.md, SYSTEM.md, Workflow/); filesRoot = the Files folder (stories, Photos, Drop/); drops = absolute drop folders in the order the intake numbers them (0 = Files Drop, 1 = phone drop); writable = true lets AR Create write the magazine, default false (every write answers 503); exportStaging = where finished social exports are staged; magSendRepo = the teajia checkout whose scripts/mag-send.mjs publishes; machine and previewPort are optional. Null vaultRoot = no magazine; <data>/magazine-vault.json is then read as a fallback.
//.tools: Absolute paths of host tools. Null = that capability is off. python = interpreter; transcriptionVenv = a virtualenv folder whose bin/python is used when python is null.
//.transcriptLibrary: {registryFile, indexFile, libraryRoot}, all absolute, or null.
//.retainedCarouselState: Optional {path, projectId, documentId, outputIds:[explicit unique UUIDs]}, or null. Use an absolute non-symlink original SPA state JSON outside the checkout. This bounded reader never imports, writes, or associates the original automatically. Missing/changed sources report unavailable. No environment-variable or request-path fallback.

retainedCarouselCopyUI.availability: GET /api/capabilities → retainedCarouselCopy. configured means an explicit host descriptor; available means its exact source metadata is readable and the native output writer exists. This does not choose or prove a destination. Surface error when unavailable; no fallback/guessing. requiresOriginalValidation is always true: availability is not a compatibility or copying-success claim for every listed original.
retainedCarouselCopyUI.source: items exposes only the configured original projectId, documentId, outputId, sourceHash, outputHash and existing allowed metadata. Never send a filesystem path. Refresh before presenting a copy.
retainedCarouselCopyUI.destination: Ask the person to explicitly select an existing ready owned-working-copy root from GET /api/study-draft/catalog. Exclude output-fork child bindings. Keep its parentStudyId/rootBindingId distinct from the original source IDs. Do not create a root, select a project, or infer an association by title/count.
retainedCarouselCopyUI.proof: GET /api/study/outputs?rootBindingId=...&parentStudyId=... supplies photoScope.projectId/documentId and expectedOutput. GET /api/study-draft/read?bindingId=<rootBindingId>&parentStudyId=... supplies expectedNative. Verify returned IDs match the chosen root/parent. If either existing owner is unavailable, stop; do not invoke select/open/create routes implicitly.
retainedCarouselCopyUI.command: After an explicit copy action, POST /api/study/outputs/copy-retained-carousel with exactly {rootBindingId,parentStudyId,destinationProjectId:<photoScope.projectId>,destinationDocumentId:<photoScope.documentId>,expectedOutput,expectedNative,operationId:<fresh UUID>,source:{projectId,documentId,outputId,sourceHash,outputHash}}. Keep an exact pending request for safe replay; never change its payload under the same operationId.
retainedCarouselCopyUI.result: Validate returned scope and new output ID, then use its existing read/edit/own-word-review/export owners. A copy never inherits approval or publication. Original photo slots and unsupported appearance metadata can refuse; do not promise every original can copy. No live reader/writer or UI activation is implied by this example.

//.browserCarouselOrigins: Optional exact HTTP loopback source origins behind the existing local proxy. The current request origin remains mandatory. No remote origins or arbitrary forwarded headers.
